C asked me to help the three of us sort out the trailer. I use NCEs to mean needs, concerns, and expectations, and I will keep a list for the group. I am adding my NCEs to the list now: fair process, safe use, clear dates, and a way to change the plan if facts change. I cannot make legal decisions or move money. Please tell me if you disagree with any of mine, and send any NCEs of your own.

C says you both want the trailer in the next few weeks. What exact dates do you need it, and for how long? Please give dates in full, like March 3, 2026, and give pickup and return times with a.m. or p.m. What is the purpose, how firm are the dates, and which parts could shift? Does the company connection with C affect the use or timing? What would be a fair fallback if both needs overlap? Please also tell me any NCEs about B's pad, pickup, return, or care of the trailer.
